purpose: Investigate a kinetic farfield that admits subsonic incoming/outgoing characteristics; do not replace all sides by an ordinary outflow or fit tunnel coefficients
candidate: Isothermal 1D Riemann-invariant reservoir state with nonequilibrium PDF extrapolation (NEEP); research approximation, not a full transverse/viscous NSCBC

derivation.tangential: fluid for outgoing advective characteristic, freestream for incoming; classify by predicted un
derivation.pdf: g_in=feq(boundary)-feq(adjacent_fluid)+g_adjacent for the incoming direction; same D3Q27 factorized equilibrium as cumulant core
derivation.sampling: Adjacent fluid at the normal foot of the ghost node; diagonal outward normal for corner ghost cells

preserve: Re, lattice speed, molecular shear viscosity, bulk relaxation, collision operator, walls, geometry, perturbation and definitions of Cl/Cd/Cm
Legacy boundary remains default unless a new mode is explicitly selected
No claim of DNS, high-Re accuracy or universal non-reflection

uniform.scope: all open faces and corners, periodic z; both inflow/outflow must preserve uniform equilibrium

normal_wave.acceptance: probe Rminus/Rplus <=0.1 and <=one fifth of the UBB ratio, same setup as 0.5.1 diagnostic

oblique_and_corners.density_pulse: amplitude2e-5, radial Gaussian sigma10, centered; initial velocity freestream (0.04,0,0)
oblique_and_corners.acceptance: At step360 core density L2 truncation error normalized by initial pulse L2 <=0.2 and <=one third of UBB error; full finite-state checks. Larger-domain result is numerical truncation control, not experimental truth

convected_shear.acceptance: finite fields; max spurious interior density error <=2e-6; at step3000 residual |uy| in x<220 <=2e-7; compare with exact advective-diffusive Gaussian, no retuning viscosity

open_budget.method: owned PDFs before/after one collide-stream update, independently enumerated open-link incoming/outgoing flux, boundary edits exposed; never invoke boundary twice

integration_if_candidate_passes: Explicit opt-in in saved grid/project, checkpoint/restart/continuation including legacy states, no silent refined/GPU fallback; installed-wheel and cold offline checks required

airfoil_after_basic_checks.case: NACA0012 finiteTE81, Re30000 alpha4 c0.15 momentc/4, N32 span0.5, Ulat0.04, seed31 perturbation0.0001, SGSnone, CPU2
airfoil_after_basic_checks.acceptance: completed finite admissible state, raw histories and experiment Cl/Cd/Cm comparison. This does not establish mesh, span or statistical convergence; do not change criteria or fit parameters after seeing a result

resources: Cloud2-core/8GiB CPU. Largest wave control1.18M cells ~1GiB PDF buffers plus overhead; actual memory bounded and recorded; Windows/GPU not_run until tested there
